# ECOS Insurance Solutions

> Home of ECOS Medicare Solutions, an independent Medicare insurance agency led by licensed agent Darin Weidauer (NPN 18580338). One website with a section for each state served. Each state section has its own local phone number, 2026 cost figures, city and region pages, and its own llms.txt / llms-full.txt summary.

ECOS Medicare Solutions is not connected with or endorsed by the United States government or the federal Medicare program. Official, independent sources: Medicare.gov, 1-800-MEDICARE (TTY 1-877-486-2048), and every state's SHIP counseling program.
